claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of cars spare parts
claims.evidence: No photo or document shows seller's inventory or business scope; this is a general sales pitch, not a claim about the item itself.

risks.risk: Alternator may not be tested/working (electrical function unknown)
risks.proof: Video clip of alternator spinning on a bench test rig or installed and running in a vehicle, showing charging output on a multimeter/voltmeter

risks.risk: No brand or part number visible, so compatibility with buyer's vehicle unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any stamped part number, brand label, or OEM sticker on housing

risks.risk: Internal wear (bearings, brushes, diode pack) cannot be assessed from exterior photos
risks.proof: Video of alternator being rotated by hand showing smooth bearing motion and no noise, plus photo of brushes/diode pack if opened
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming worn internals, worst case near end-of-life

risks.risk: Connector plug and pulley may not match buyer's car
risks.proof: Close-up photo of connector pin layout and pulley groove count/diameter with a ruler for scale
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fit, buyer bears compatibility risk

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle source/age/mileage of part, affecting remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Seller statement with proof, e.g. photo of the donor vehicle or receipt/invoice showing removal date
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-age used part, worst case

risks.risk: No warranty or return policy stated
risks.proof: Screenshot or written confirmation from seller of return/warranty terms
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold as-is, no recourse

proof_requests: Video of alternator spinning freely by hand or on a test bench with voltage output shown on a multimeter
Close-up photo of any stamped part number or brand marking on the housing
Close-up photo of the connector plug pins and pulley groove count/size with a ruler
Any documentation or photo showing the donor vehicle make/model/year
Written confirmation of warranty or return policy
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a used car alternator, so it can be priced at worst case (untested, unbranded, unknown fit) with proof requests listed to potentially raise the price; the seller's remark is a generic sales pitch and does not change the item or its condition.
